intent: edit existing Pencil atlases; preserve pictograms and add colored-pencil pigment

prompts.01-library.png:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent Calibre icon atlas, Pencil Color variant.
Edit target: the supplied monochrome Pencil atlas. Colorize these SAME 36 drawings as colored-pencil drawings. Keep exactly the same subjects, their shapes, details, orientation, relative size and placement in the existing 6 by 6 grid. Preserve hand-drawn repeated graphite contours, fine pencil grain, diagonal cross-hatching and imperfect handmade edges. Add tasteful rich colored-pencil pigment shading inside each object, with darker colored-pencil contours; keep paper pages pale cream. Use a harmonious varied palette of teal, leaf green, terracotta coral, ochre yellow, periwinkle blue and muted violet. Each object should have meaningful two- or three-color details. Keep all 36 icons separate, fully inside their own cell with clear transparent gutters. Background must be genuinely transparent, including holes. Remove stray background smudges; no paper backdrop, no sticker white borders, no glossy finish, no 3D, no gradients, no extra symbols, no rearranging, no missing icons. The result must look like the original Pencil set carefully colored by hand, preserving every original pictogram.
Color details: Books teal and coral, add badge green, paper cream with teal pencil, conversion arrows teal and ochre, paper plane blue, save violet. Trash coral, sparkles ochre, books varied colors, tags coral, person blue, folders ochre, heart coral, star ochre.
